name: startup-lifecycle-toolkit
description: Complete guide to the founder journey from zero money to raising venture capital. Covers savings, offshore entity formation (Delaware PBC, Wyoming LLC), fundraising (SAFE notes, cap table, investor matching, demo prep, financial modeling), vesting (4-year + 1-year cliff, acceleration), co-founder matching, advisor matching, B Corp certification, Cayman Sandwich structure, and converting LATAM entities to wholly owned subsidiaries. For founders with no experience in the US ecosystem. FREE.
